newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-RUSSIAN CEN. BANK SELLS 50.00 BLN RBLS BONDS.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-RUSSIAN CEN. BANK SELLS 50.00 BLN RBLS BONDS.

text.p: The central bank sold 50.00 billion roubles ($8.6 million) nominal of OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Monday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 24017 issue closed on Monday at 96.26 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
